t: 皇家交易所在伦敦开幕.
te: The Royal Exchange opens in London.
dz: 皇家交易所在伦敦开幕.
de: The Royal Exchange opens in London.

t: 瓦莱塔是马耳他的首都.
te: Valletta is made the capital city of Malta.
dz: 瓦莱塔是马耳他的首都.
de: Valletta is made the capital city of Malta.

t: 威尼斯,西班牙,那不勒斯,教宗国等意大利国家建立了"神圣联盟"来与奥斯曼人作战,结果于同年晚些…
te: Venice, Spain, Naples, the Papal States, and other Italian states establish the Holy League to fight the Ottomans, resu…
dz: 威尼斯,西班牙,那不勒斯,教宗国等意大利国家建立了"神圣联盟"来与奥斯曼人作战,结果于同年晚些时候在勒潘托取得了胜利.
de: Venice, Spain, Naples, the Papal States, and other Italian states establish the Holy League to fight the Ottomans, resulting in the victory at Lepanto later that year.

t: 米格尔·洛佩斯·黎牙实比 (Miguel López de Legazpi) 为西班牙征服马尼…
te: Miguel López de Legazpi conquers Manila for Spain, modern day capital of the Philippines.
dz: 米格尔·洛佩斯·黎牙实比 (Miguel López de Legazpi) 为西班牙征服马尼拉，成为菲律宾的现代首都。
de: Miguel López de Legazpi conquers Manila for Spain, modern day capital of the Philippines.

t: 拉古纳省(Laguna encomienda),今天被称作菲律宾拉古纳省,由西班牙人建立,是该…
te: La Laguna encomienda, known today as the Laguna province in the Philippines, is founded by the Spaniards as one of the …
dz: 拉古纳省(Laguna encomienda),今天被称作菲律宾拉古纳省,由西班牙人建立,是该国最古老的省会之一.
de: La Laguna encomienda, known today as the Laguna province in the Philippines, is founded by the Spaniards as one of the oldest encomiendas (provinces) in the country.

t: 奥斯曼对塞浦路斯的征服以法马古斯塔投降而告终.
te: The Ottoman conquest of Cyprus is concluded, by the surrender of Famagusta.
dz: 奥斯曼对塞浦路斯的征服以法马古斯塔投降而告终.
de: The Ottoman conquest of Cyprus is concluded, by the surrender of Famagusta.

t: 托马斯·霍华德(Thomas Howard,4th Duke of Norfolk)因出演了里…
te: Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, is arrested for his role in the Ridolfi plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth I of En…
dz: 托马斯·霍华德(Thomas Howard,4th Duke of Norfolk)因出演了里多尔菲暗杀英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世的阴谋而被捕,取而代之的是苏格兰女王玛丽.
de: Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, is arrested for his role in the Ridolfi plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth I of England and replace her with Mary, Queen of Scots.

t: 莱潘托战役被打倒,奥斯曼海军遭受了第一次战败.
te: The Battle of Lepanto is fought, and the Ottoman Navy suffers its first defeat.
dz: 莱潘托战役被打倒,奥斯曼海军遭受了第一次战败.
de: The Battle of Lepanto is fought, and the Ottoman Navy suffers its first defeat.
